posts.name: Nataraja
posts.cooked:
Put 1 token in the hero favor pool when any of these things occur: A hero target deals 2 or more damage to multiple non-hero targets in a single round

Put 1 token in the Bloodsworn favor pool when any of these things occur: A villain target deals 2 or more damage to multiple non-villain targets in a single round

 

First, I suppose a round is a complete sequence of turns: from the villain turn to the environment turn, through the heroes' turns

Is the favor awarded once per every target earning it or once per instance of multiple damage happening (even coming from the same target multiple times) or even once per game round per side?

Example: three heroes game, hero A manages to damage 2 villain targets for 2 damage each during his turn. Hero B manages to damage 2 targets for 2 each with a card and do it again with a power, all during her turn. Hero C doesn't deal damage at all.

How many total favor tokens did the heroes earn? 2, 3 or 1? Obviously not considering titles awarded or targets destroyed

Also, when is it approriate to award thoe tokens? As soon as the condition for awarding them is fulfilled? I ask because if it was "once per game round stop" it would make sense if the condition was only checked at the end of the round

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
The damage to earn a point is by target, so in your example as soon as Hero A deals the second target the 2 damage the heroes earn a point.

As soon as Hero B deals the second target the 2 damage the heroes earn a point.  The damage dealt by the power is irrelevant, that hero already earned their point for dealing 2 damage to 2 targets in a round, and cannot earn another point for achieving that until the next round.

If Expat uses her assault rifle to deal 3 targets 2 damage on her turn she gets a point, is that same round Adept lets her use a power and she does it again, she gets no more points, because it isn't a new round yet.

Hero C deals no damage, is awarded no points, and may God have mercy on their soul.
